# Supported file changes affect new requests and an already attached stream.
# Token outputs and auth files in this workdir need a private parent.
chmod 0700 .
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add bob --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add auditor --role admin --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue bob --auth-file $AUTH --output bob.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue auditor --auth-file $AUTH --output auditor.token --expires-in 24h
server start
taskfile hold.json hold
taskfile success.json success
skygo --token-file bob.token --json run -f hold.json --request-id bob-live
job-id BOB
await-file ready
skygo --token-file auditor.token --json run -f success.json --request-id auditor-own --wait
skygo --token-file auditor.token --json jobs list --page-size 1
page-token AUDITOR_PAGE

# A demoted admin cannot retain an active foreign log stream. Its credential
# remains valid for shared reads, but foreign access disappears within budget.
! skygo --token-file auditor.token jobs logs $BOB --follow &
await-stdout '^holding\n$'
skygo auth principal set-role auditor --role reader --auth-file $AUTH
auth-window
wait
stderr '^(permission_denied|not_found): '
! stderr 'auth stream timeout'
env SKYGO_EXIT_CODE
stdout '^SKYGO_EXIT_CODE=1\n$'
await-auth allowed auditor.token targets list
! skygo --token-file auditor.token jobs get $BOB
stderr '^not_found: '
! skygo --token-file auditor.token jobs list --page-token $AUDITOR_PAGE
stderr '^invalid_argument: '

# A reader keeps its own previously accepted work and logs, but loses mutation.
skygo --token-file alice.token --json run -f hold.json --request-id alice-live
job-id ALICE
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $ALICE --follow &
await-stdout '^holding\n$'
skygo auth principal set-role alice --role reader --auth-file $AUTH
auth-window
wait
stderr '^permission_denied: '
! stderr 'auth stream timeout'
env SKYGO_EXIT_CODE
stdout '^SKYGO_EXIT_CODE=1\n$'
await-auth permission_denied alice.token jobs cancel 00000000000000000000000000000000 --yes
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs cancel $ALICE --yes
stderr '^permission_denied: '
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs get $ALICE
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $ALICE
stdout '^holding\n$'

# Revoking a live follower's credential closes the stream and new requests;
# neither revocation nor the disconnect cancels the accepted workload.
token-id alice.token ALICE_TOKEN
! skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $ALICE --follow &
await-stdout '^holding\n$'
skygo auth token revoke $ALICE_TOKEN --auth-file $AUTH
auth-window
wait
stderr '^unauthenticated: '
! stderr 'auth stream timeout'
env SKYGO_EXIT_CODE
stdout '^SKYGO_EXIT_CODE=1\n$'
await-auth unauthenticated alice.token jobs get $ALICE
skygo --token-file admin.token --json jobs get $ALICE
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_RUNNING"'
! stdout 'cancel_requested'
skygo --token-file admin.token --json jobs get $BOB
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_RUNNING"'
! stdout 'cancel_requested'
skygo --token-file admin.token jobs cancel $ALICE --yes
skygo --token-file admin.token jobs cancel $BOB --yes
server stop
! stderr .
